question.worked_solution:
The sum takes integer values of $m$ from $2$ to $5.$ So, computing the terms for $m=2,3,4,5$ and then adding them, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{m=2}^{5}\frac{2m+1}{10} & =\frac{2\cdot 2+1}{10}+\frac{2\cdot 3+1}{10}+\frac{2\cdot 4+1}{10}+\frac{2\cdot 5+1}{10} \\  & =\frac{5}{10}+\frac{7}{10}+\frac{9}{10}+\frac{11}{10} \\  & =\frac{5+7+9+11}{10} \\  & =\frac{32}{10} \\  & =\frac{\cancel{2}\cdot 16}{\cancel{2}\cdot 5} \\  & =\frac{16}{5}.\end{aligned}
$$
